observations.body: Receiving the Spirit leads back to Abraham’s faith. Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified? So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.
observations.label: Receiving the Spirit leads back to Abraham’s faith

payload.posture: Read Galatians 3:1–9 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states receiving the Spirit leads back to Abraham’s faith. Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified? So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
payload.title: Receiving the Spirit leads back to Abraham’s faith
